svg.title: Built for the agent loop.
svg.desc: CLICKS + DOM UPDATE: Umbra 1.52 ms; Playwright Chromium 16.02 ms (10.5×); Playwright WebKit 65.85 ms (43.3×); ACCESSIBILITY SNAPSHOTS: Umbra 0.94 ms; Playwright Chromium 3.57 ms (3.8×); Playwright WebKit 4.41 ms (4.7×). Same local fixtures · 20-run medians · Apple M1 Pro · recorded 2026-10-13. Umbra daemon socket vs Playwright 1.62.1 drivers. Excludes fresh CLI/MCP overhead. Clicks include each tool’s actionability policy.
